dataset: AEOeye AI brand recommendation benchmark — answer-level aggregates
snapshot: Completed AEOeye audits created 2026-06-26 → 2026-09-07 (no audits completed after 2026-09-07 at extraction time, 2026-10-03)
inclusion: status = complete; excludes example / test / AEOeye / localhost rows (3 audits). Repeat audits of the same brand are kept. Brand names, domains, questions and answers are not published.
unit: One answer = one AI engine answering one buyer-style question in one audit. 'Mentioned' = the engine's answer named the audited brand (judged by AEOeye's analysis model, then stored per answer).
caveats: Self-selected sample: brands whose owners (or AEOeye) chose to run an audit; repeats included. Not a market estimate.

Engine samples are unequal and not comparable: until mid-2026 the free audit ran on Claude only, so Claude has 509 answers; the other engines mostly come from full reports and later free audits on different brands and questions.
Four of five engines have fewer than 10 mentions — their rates have very wide uncertainty.
usedSearch was only recorded for recent answers (see usedSearchKnown per engine).
previousVersion: The 2026-08-30 snapshot (108 audits, 838 answers, 18.7% mention rate) used the same inclusion rule on a shorter window.
